return_path.description: also ask Forward for the return flow (destination back to source) and summarize it; warns when the forward flow is delivered but the return is not

explain.description: routes: add to each hop the forwarding entry its device holds for dst_ip (longest prefix in the hop's VRF, from Forward's forwarding table: prefix, next hops, vrf_from). trace (PREVIEW, undocumented Forward routes): add Forward's GUI flow trace of each distinct path, unchanged (headers per hop, functions by layer with config line ranges, NAT rewrites, processing stages). One flow only, IPv4

intent.description: how Forward orders and selects the paths it returns

matrix.description: a reachability matrix instead of one flow: every ordered pair of endpoints searched in one bulk request (protocol, src_port, dst_port, intent and snapshot_id apply to all), each pair compared with its reverse so asymmetric routing is named. Does not combine with src_ip, dst_ip, from or return_path.

endpoints.description: 2 to 40 endpoints (every ordered pair is searched)

pattern.description: a regular expression matched against each hop device name

max_overall_seconds.description: time for the whole request (default 300, at most 3000, which is under Forward's one hour limit for a large job)
